levels.name: Fatal Acceleration
levels.description: Upon scoring a CRIT Hit, increases ATK SPD of Xinyan's Normal and Charged Attacks by 12% for 5s. Can only occur once every 5s.

levels.name: Impromptu Opening
levels.description: Riff Revolution's Physical DMG has its CRIT Rate increased by 100%, and will form a shield at Shield Level 3: Rave when cast.

levels.name: Double-Stop
levels.description: Increases the Level of Sweeping Fervor by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Wildfire Rhythm
levels.description: Sweeping Fervor's swing DMG decreases opponent's Physical RES by 15% for 12s.

levels.name: Screamin' for an Encore
levels.description: Increases the Level of Riff Revolution by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Rockin' in a Flaming World
levels.description: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Xinyan's Charged Attacks by 30%. Additionally, Xinyan's Charged Attacks gain an ATK Bonus equal to 50% of her DEF.
